ikeda_identity_evidence: The byline and investigator appendix both identify the same Hiroko Ikeda at the Shizuoka Institute of Epilepsy and Neurological Disorders.

A5102864263 indexes her clinical epilepsy/TSC publications, including EXIST-3. https://www.ilae.org/about-ilae/awards/epileptic-disorders-educational-prize/hiroko-ikeda-2017 corroborates her Shizuoka affiliation.

https://pub.orcid.org/v3.0/0000-0002-7278-7282/record identifies the conflicting profile as a Hoshi University researcher. This profile is removed only from this paper, not globally merged with the clinician.
